summary: Record withdrawal and decline of unclaimed person handoffs without completing work

replay.detail: work.handoff-returned durably restores the handing agent's assignment and readiness. Replay preserves attempts, progress, evidence and completion state; resolved notes no longer block claims.

schema.detail: Adds the durable work.handoff-returned claim kind with exact handoff, actor, disposition, reason and retry identity. No database migration or client operation is added.

rules.detail: Only the handing agent may withdraw or the assigned person decline an exact ready, unclaimed person handoff in the current live generation.

compatibility.detail: Store callers can return pending or acknowledged handoffs without answers, acknowledgments, read receipts, acceptance or completion. Generic person work and asks are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond normal daemon replacement.

manual.detail: No configuration conversion or data repair is required.

recovery.detail: Exact retries recover the original disposition record after subsequent work. Use an updated projector when replaying returned handoffs; older projectors do not restore their assignment.
